description: The file defines Lua functions for rendering a menu bar UI component, including Menuitem and Menubar, using a custom 'luax' library for HTML element creation and mapping over options.

methods.name: Menuitem
methods.description: Creates a list item with a link and optional submenu based on provided properties.

methods.name: Menubar
methods.description: Creates a menu bar containing multiple menu items based on provided buttons.
